profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Preferences, bank accounts, categories and history

identity.demoNote: The data in this account is fictional and lives only in this browser tab. Nothing is sent to a server, and everything is discarded when you close the tab.

security.title: Security
security.passwordHint: Change the password for this account.
security.passwordDemo: Not available in the demo: this account has no password.
security.modalDescription: The new password applies from your next sign-in.
security.tooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
security.error: Couldn't change the password. Please try again.

data.title: Data and session
data.restoreHint: Discards your changes and goes back to the original sample data.
data.restoreConfirmText: Accounts, transactions, goals and categories go back to their initial state. Changes made in this tab will be discarded.
data.exitDemoHint: Clears this tab's data and returns to the sign-in screen.
data.signOutHint: You'll return to the sign-in screen in this browser.
data.signOutError: Couldn't sign out. Please try again.

accounts.title: Accounts and cards
accounts.emptyText: Add the accounts and cards you use to record transactions, import statements and keep track of your balance.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.balanceHint: For a credit card, enter the open statement as a negative amount.
accounts.nameRequired: Enter a name for the account.
accounts.balanceInvalid: Enter a valid amount, such as 1,250.00.
accounts.saveError: Couldn't save the account. Please try again.
accounts.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be removed from the list and the total balance. Transactions already recorded stay in Transactions.

categories.customSubtitle: Rename them, change their color or delete them.
categories.defaultSubtitle: Used to categorize imported statements automatically, so they can't be edited or deleted.
categories.emptyText: Create categories for spending the defaults don't cover, such as pets or travel.
categories.name: Name
categories.nameRequired: Enter a name for the category.
categories.nameTaken: A category with this name already exists.
categories.saveError: Couldn't save the category. Please try again.
categories.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be deleted. Its transactions will be left uncategorized.

history.title: Change history
history.subtitle: The last 50 changes to transactions. Undo reverts a change and adjusts the account balance.
history.undoCreate: The transaction “{{name}}” ({{amount}}) will be removed and the account balance adjusted.
history.undoUpdate: The transaction “{{name}}” goes back to its previous values.
history.undoDelete: The transaction “{{name}}” ({{amount}}) returns to the list and the account balance is adjusted.
history.emptyText: When you add, edit or delete transactions, they show up here and can be undone.
